title.suggested: Tom Allen Nearly Fights Sherman Thurston in Cincinnati

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reprinted Cincinnati reports that Sherman Thurston, upset at being left out by his old friend Allen, nearly came to blows with him at the Buckeye House days before the McCoole fight.

metadata.notes: The masthead reads 'Daily Democrat, Thursday Morning, Nov. 4, 1869.' The item reprints the Cincinnati Enquirer and Commercial.

facts.fact: Allen was staying at the Buckeye House in Cincinnati before his November 1869 fight with McCoole, where crowds came to see him
Allen quarreled with his old friend Sherman Thurston, who had come from St. Louis, at the Buckeye House; it nearly became a fight but was settled with a drink and a handshake

notes: The quarrel was 'yesterday' in the Monday Enquirer (so Sunday, Oct. 31, 1869). The item also reports McCoole leaving for Kentucky and Jack Looney arranging McCoole's quarters at Shady Grove.
